description: The person who loves stars, space, planets, galaxies, and everything related to the universe can join in this team
summary:
Today, we are presenting our project titled "SPACE TIME CAPSULE – Abandoned but Not Forgotten."
Have you ever wondered what happens to the machines NASA sends to the Moon and Mars after their missions are completed?
Do they return to Earth? Do they disappear? Or do they remain on those distant worlds?
The answer is fascinating. Many of these machines remain on the Moon and Mars, silently preserving the history of human exploration.
Our project is an interactive digital museum that brings these forgotten machines back to life through storytelling.
Using photographs, interactive maps, mission timelines and educational games, we help people discover the stories behind NASA's abandoned equipment.
We also highlight their achievements, scientific discoveries and contributions to space exploration.
Our goal is not just to remember old machines, but to celebrate the incredible journeys and discoveries they made possible.
Because every machine has a mission, every mission has a story, and every story inspires a new discovery.
